visualCharacteristics: Two-column text and image: title, text and CTA beside an image; optional reversed order and grey band with wave.
contentPattern: One row: cell 1 title/text/CTA, cell 2 image.
usage: The main content building block on static, product and locale home pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any text-beside-image section; alternate with reverse for zig-zag layouts.
